description: Get monthly Spotify and Netflix plan prices in local currency for a list of 2 letter country codes. One row per plan per country, with the price text as shown and a numeric price.

countries.description: 2 letter country codes, such as US, DE, IN, BR, or JP. UK and GB both mean the United Kingdom. Up to 250. Each country is read once per service.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

services.description: spotify, netflix, or both. Default both. Spotify rows cost less, because Netflix must be read from an address in each country.

name: get_streaming_prices_by_country
title: Get streaming prices by country
